title: Local criterion bridge for polynomial chart stalk flatness
statement: Under the polynomial chart hypotheses, base stalk flatness and polynomial fibre stalk flatness imply chart stalk flatness together with locality of the chart stalk map.

proof.text: Project the flatness component of the ring bridge. The explicit locality hypotheses are redundant because all scheme stalk maps are local.

proof_origin.place: Tags 00R7 and 00RH. The unused locality wrapper is retired after the upstream auxiliary bypassed it; the node is retained as history.
